description: This PHP source file generates a bar chart visualization for top-level test suite results within the TestLink test management system. It initializes configuration, retrieves test data, processes it, and creates a chart, including functions for data retrieval and argument initialization.

methods.name: getDataAndScale
methods.description: Retrieves test suite data and scales for the chart, processing test results, and preparing data series for visualization.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes input arguments, manages authentication for remote or anonymous access, and prepares parameters for data retrieval.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view test plan metrics.
